title: Introducing: Approvals for the Expense Agent (2026 release wave 1)

chapters.title: Introduction to Approvals for the Expense Agent
Setup and Configuration in Business Central

features.name: Approvals for the Expense Agent
features.description: A new approval workflow system for expense reports submitted through the AI-powered expense agent. Approvers receive notifications via email or Copilot chat and can approve, reject, or request changes to expense reports.
caveats: Approvers must have a Business Central license
UI may be tweaked before final release

features.name: Pre-approval AI Suggestions
features.description: The AI model makes decisions and suggestions on whether a receipt follows company policy before the expense report is submitted for approval.

features.name: Expense User Configuration
features.description: A new page in Business Central called the Expense Users page where admins can define expense users and mark them as approvers with a can approve flag.
caveats: The UI is not fully final so we might tweak a few things around

features.name: Team-based Approval Setup
features.description: Support for setting up expense approval through teams where a team manager can approve expenses for their team members.

features.name: Approval Notifications via Email and Copilot Chat
features.description: Approvers receive notifications about pending expense reports through email or Copilot chat when reports are submitted for approval.

features.name: Expense Report Rejection and Revision
features.description: Approvers can reject or send back expense reports requesting additional information or changes from the submitter, who can then revise and resubmit.

features.name: Approval Registration in Business Central
features.description: Once approved, the approval decision is registered in Business Central and all financial consequences including posting data to GL reports are handled within Business Central.
